facts.text: Serve the snacks when Viktor Drago runs the dawn streets of Kyiv with his father watching.
facts.why: The plot says Viktor trains under Ivan in Ukraine and suffers torturous physical tests at Ivan's hands, but no source opened names Kyiv or shows dawn runs.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Ivan puts Viktor through his training in Ukraine.

facts.why: In the plot Adonis proposes to Bianca after winning the WBC title, before she suggests moving to Los Angeles. The proposal is not in LA.

facts.text: Adonis has a ring in his pocket and a speech he can't get out
facts.why: The proposal is in the plot, but no source opened shows the ring in his pocket or a speech he can't finish.
facts.fix: Adonis proposes to Bianca after the title fight

facts.why: The plot has Rocky and Little Duke retraining Adonis in a decrepit site in the California desert, but IMDb and Wikipedia give it no name, so 'The Pit' is not confirmed.
Same as the cue. Kyiv and dawn runs are not in the sources opened. The Kyiv deruny note 'fuel for the dawn runs through Kyiv' has the same problem.
facts.fix: Viktor training under Ivan back in Ukraine

facts.text: Ask the desk about Swinging the sledgehammer in the desert.
facts.why: The desert training is in the plot, but no source opened mentions a sledgehammer in that scene.

vibe.verdict: A desert postcard that gets the Dragos and Little Duke right, but it leans on details no source confirms and has little from the fight itself.
missing: Ivan Drago throwing in the towel to save Viktor (Moscow)
Viktor disqualified for hitting Adonis while he was down (the first fight)
Adonis's bad injury, then Rocky coming back to train him (the desert)
Rocky meeting his grandson Logan in Vancouver
Bianca's daughter Amara born deaf, and her new hearing aids
The 1967 Ford Mustang Adonis won back from Wheeler
ideas: Swap 'Desert camp watermelon agua fresca' note for 'Rocky and Little Duke retrain him.'
Swap 'Moscow fight night honey cake' note for 'Ivan throws in the towel.'
Swap 'The Pit desert camp chilli' note for the Rocky and Adonis argument about the challenge.
Swap the 'Coffee shop, open 6 till 10' line for 'Rocky's restaurant, Philadelphia' to fit the Adrian's dish.
